metadata.mechanics: The user gains "Upsurge: Spend 1 Resolve to make a Psionic Attack, call 'Downsurge: No Aberrant Skill or Benediction Use, Overwhelm'". Alternatively, the Benediction may Target a Consecrated Space, destroying it and preventing the area from being Consecrated for the rest of the event. It may also Target a plot item connected to a faith, with effects as decided by the Guide on scene.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted to Final Knights
metadata.validTargetDescription: Self or Target (Consecrated Area or Faith Object)
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: The Final Knight performing this Benediction must spend ten minutes in some manner of ritualized behavior condemning other faiths for their falsehoods they claim as truth, often specifically targeting one faith that they intend on targeting with the effects of the Benediction. This can take the form of formal ranting, accusations, or ritual destruction of sacred objects.
